title: Add transactional handoff runtime-dispatch tests: commit after protected response, rollback on sender-state persistence failure
description: Bead project-LICHEN-worker6-shvq decomposition (tests portion 1). The transactional production fix is already committed (e72604e715): Gateway::dispatch_runtime_gcp stages handoff via stage_post_handoff, sends the OSCORE-protected response, commits commit_staged_handoff only on Ok, and rollback_staged_handoff on Err. Missing tests in rust/lichen-gateway/tests/end_to_end.rs, adapting the runtime_ingress_dispatches_authenticated_gcp_slot_claim harness: (1) happy path: node registered in GatewayCoordinator registry, gateway-B client POSTs /.well-known/lichen-gw/handoff through ingest_mesh_frame_at_superframe, protected success response is decryptable by the client, then re-POST returns NodeNotFound (node was released only after protected delivery); (2) persistence boundary: persistent gateway whose gcp-oscore-sender storage directory is chmod 0500 after context install -> GatewayOscoreSenderStore::compare_exchange fails Io -> send_secure_response errors -> rollback; assert node remains registered and retryable (re-POST stages successfully again). NOTE: end_to_end.rs currently fails at state-dir creation with 'state directory must have mode 0700' (see project-LICHEN-worker6-XXXX perms bead); tests must use a private_test_dir-style 0700 helper. Must also fix/coordinate the currently-broken runtime_ingress_dispatches_authenticated_gcp_slot_claim harness setup.
